abstract: FactSet analyzed S&P 500 earnings call transcripts from Q1 2023 (March 15-May 25) and found that 110 companies cited the term 'AI,' representing the highest number in over a decade and well above the 5-year average of 57 companies. Information Technology, Industrials, and Communication Services sectors led mentions, with 46 companies specifically discussing generative AI.
keyFindings: 110 S&P 500 companies cited 'AI' on Q1 2023 earnings calls, the highest number since at least 2010 when current index constituents are used historically.
AI mentions more than doubled compared to the 5-year average of 57 companies and the 10-year average of 34 companies.

Information Technology (38 companies), Industrials (17 companies), and Communication Services (15 companies) sectors had the most AI mentions, with Information Technology and Communication Services having the highest percentages at 66% and 75% respectively.
46 S&P 500 companies cited 'generative AI' specifically during Q1 earnings calls.
The previous record for AI mentions was 78 companies in Q4 2022.
methodology: FactSet Document Search was used to search for the term 'AI' in conference call transcripts of S&P 500 companies that conducted earnings calls from March 15 through May 25, 2023. Analysis compared Q1 2023 results to 5-year and 10-year historical averages using current index constituents back in time.
